material.MATERIAL_UNIT: sum of the continuous matter field m over the tracked component (mass), NOT site count
material.doses_expressed_in: fractions of M256, never of N0

mask_algorithm: frozen in od_core.build_masks: sink = downstream half of C256 (proj>0); source_near = graph distance EXACTLY 2 from C256 and upstream; source_far = graph distance >= 4 and upstream; the distributed sink priority avoids 4-adjacent picks within one event while non-adjacent candidates remain; the contiguous sink priority sorts by angular distance from the axis. Masks are built ONCE at t256 in absolute coordinates and never follow the current track.

reservoirs.OUTGOING_PROVENANCE: sink reservoir, never re-injected as fresh in the same trajectory
reservoirs.balance: lattice + reservoirs exact for every arm; lattice-only exact for COUPLED arms

joint_endpoint.name: TOLERATED_DIRECTIONAL_MICROFLOW_H2048
clauses: same track continuously valid from t256 to t2048
bounded, nonwrapping, nonmerged, not track-lost at 1536 and 2048
joint_endpoint.ingress_credit: fresh mass is credited only when measured inside the track at a checkpoint, which is at least one full engine interval after injection since source sites are non-adjacent to the track

prephase_yield_rule: T256_VALID >= 7/9 per size, else PREPHASE_YIELD_INSUFFICIENT; no replacement seed
fixtures: operator_decomposition_fixtures.json — 10 checks, all PASS. Fixture 7 was corrected MECHANICALLY BEFORE this preseal: the original specification exercised the OPERATOR (whole-cell removal fragments the block and shrinks the track, so the residual fell 0.15 instead of 0.10) where the required test is of the MEASUREMENT; it now applies a distributed PARTIAL removal that leaves every cell above threshold and the track set unchanged, and the residual falls by exactly the removed fraction.
